column1: # Declared differences between the local loop (check.sh) and CI (ci.yml).

# surface and not the other and is not listed here. The asymmetry is always real
# and always invisible from one side, so the honest options are "make them the

column2: ci.yml runs the full build lifecycle because it is the only place that assembles the bootJar and proves the image can be packaged. Locally that is `just app::build bootJar`, which is slower than the compile check check.sh uses.

check.sh compiles the app module explicitly so a Spring wiring error surfaces in the local loop with a readable message, rather than as part of a multi-minute `build`. CI gets the same coverage from `build`, which depends on compilation.
